infobox.usage: - Unlocks two additional extractions and a room on Factory - Unlocks an extraction on Customs - Unlocks the doors to the guard building of the crane yard on Customs

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Factory emergency exit key (Factory) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A somewhat fragile factory emergency exit door key.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- Used in Therapist's quest Health Care Privacy - Part 6
- Used in Fence's quest Is This a Reference?

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- On a table next to the broken TV in the guard desk office located in the three-story dorms

- In a blue locker inside warehouse #7.

sections.heading: Factory
sections.text:
Two additional extractions and a locked room next to the office:
- Med Tent Gate extraction

- Cellars extraction in the underground

- Locked room on the 3rd floor of the office area

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- Two doors to the guard building of the crane yard next to the new gas station

- Door leading to the ZB-013 extraction in the basement of the Scav base

sections.heading: Factory
sections.text:
- Med Tent Gate extraction
- Cellars extraction in the underground
- Locked room on the 3rd floor of the office area:
  - Portable bunkhouse key spawn location
  - 1x Jacket

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- ZB-013 extraction
- Crane yard guard building:
  - Loose loot (Weapon mods)
  - TerraGroup Labs arsenal storage room key spawn location
  - 1x Drawer
  - 1x Wooden crate

sections.heading: Trading
sections.text: | Factory emergency exit key x1; Factory emergency exit key (used); +; Iskra ration pack x3; Iskra ration pack; +; MRE ration pack x1; MRE ration pack | → | Jaeger; Jaeger LL2 | → | Factory emergency exit key; Factory emergency exit key |

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The key also erroneously unlocks the always empty driver's cabs of various trucks in the game.
